verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows no documented OCI capability for exporting all of a user's data in open formats or for an exit or offboarding path. The CLI, REST APIs, SDKs and Terraform provider are general building blocks, not an export feature. The CSV user import and Terraform state import go into OCI, not out of it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
